classification: coordinator-confirmed correction/clarification; not scientific final acceptance

clarifications.kp_identity: Atom identifiers are local to the declared object and map_namespace. Evaluate identity, closure topology and reacting atoms after applying an explicit chemically valid bijective remapping; a changed numeric label alone is not a chemical error.

reuse_and_limits: Previously recorded source minima/MEP and local models can be reused only under their actual graph and namespace. This repair validates label invariance, not new pathways or selectivity.
remaining_validation: Future graph-to-artifact binding must apply the supplied bijection and retain stereochemistry. Chemical selectivity/pathway calibration is unchanged and remains unvalidated by this textual repair.
partial_full_policy: Assess completion against the original public scientific question, not a self-narrowed addressed_scope. Missing necessary investigation, a failed calculation, copied public source values or a statement of source ambiguity earns no credit for the missing work and cannot yield whole-task full credit. Preserve credit for independently valid completed parts and accept sufficiently supported non-author conclusions without a fixed route or extra method matrix.
